```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(lmerTest)
library(stats)
library(car)
setwd("~/GitHub/longitudinal_exposure_modeling")
load("AnalyticData_11.10.2025.RData")
#work purely with the growth modeling data frame 
load("PFAS_Cleaned_4Continuous_5Binary.RData")

library(readxl)
thresholds <- read_excel("Final Results ACNC 2025.xlsx", sheet = 2) 
thresholds$PFAS <- gsub(" ", ".", thresholds$PFAS)
thresholds = data.frame(thresholds)
```

```{r}
pfas_vars <- pfas5.dt %>% select(contains("PF")) %>% colnames()

# Define timepoints of interest -- adjust as needed to match variable in your data
timepoints <- c(6, 24)

age_var <- "Visitmo"  # or "visit_month" etc.


# Initialize result
results <- list()


  for(month in timepoints) {
    dat <- pfas5.dt %>%
      filter(.data[[age_var]] == month)
    for(pfas in pfas_vars) {
        n_total <- nrow(dat)
        n_above <- sum(dat[[pfas]])
        prop <-  n_above / n_total
        results <- append(results, list(data.frame(
          Month = month,
          PFAS = pfas, 
          PropAboveLOD = prop,
          N = n_total
        )))
      }
    }
  

# Combine result list to dataframe
results_df <- bind_rows(results)
knitr::kable(results_df, digits=2)
```



#Table of the detection rate of each PFAS, stratified by 6mo, 24mo, 60mo, and by study.
```{r}
# PFAS names (must match colnames in pfas4.dt)
pfas_vars <- pfas4.dt %>% select(contains("PF")) %>% colnames()

# Define timepoints of interest -- adjust as needed to match variable in your data
timepoints <- c(6, 24, 60)

age_var <- "Visitmo"  # or "visit_month" etc.

# Study variable
study_var <- "Study.GE"

# Initialize result
results <- list()

for(study in c("Glowing", "Expecting")) {
  for(month in timepoints) {
    dat <- pfas4.dt %>%
      filter(.data[[study_var]] == study, .data[[age_var]] == month)
    for(pfas in pfas_vars) {
      lod <- thresholds %>% filter(PFAS == pfas) %>% pull(LOQ)  
      if(length(lod) == 1) {
        n_total <- sum(!is.na(dat[[pfas]]))
        n_above <- sum(dat[[pfas]] > lod, na.rm=TRUE)
        prop <- ifelse(n_total > 0, n_above / n_total, NA)
        results <- append(results, list(data.frame(
          Study = study,
          Month = month,
          PFAS = pfas,
          LOD = lod, 
          PropAboveLOD = prop,
          N = n_total
        )))
      }
    }
  }
}
# Combine result list to dataframe
results_df <- bind_rows(results)
knitr::kable(results_df, digits=2)

```
#6 mo and 24 mo glowing IDS above the LOD for both time points 
```{r}

# PFAS names should match your dataset and the thresholds file
pfas_vars <- pfas4.dt %>% select(contains("PF")) %>% colnames()

# Data frame to save results
results <- data.frame()

#some ids only have one recording ex: G-116 
# 125 ids have both 6 mo and 24 mo data 
dat <- pfas4.dt %>% 
      filter(Study.GE == "Glowing") %>% 
      filter(Visitmo == 6 | Visitmo == 24) %>%  
      group_by(StudyID.GE) %>%
      filter(n() == 2) %>%
      ungroup()
 
#saving ids below LOD for 6 or 24 month pfas 
belowLOD = list()

  for (pfas in pfas_vars) {
    lod <- thresholds$LOQ[which(thresholds$PFAS == pfas)]
      n_total <- sum(!is.na(dat[[pfas]]))
      n_above <- sum(dat[[pfas]] > lod, na.rm=TRUE)
      prop_above <- ifelse(n_total > 0, n_above / n_total, NA)
      results <- rbind(results, data.frame(
        PFAS = pfas,
        PropAboveLOD = prop_above,
        N = n_total
      ))
      
    if(n_above != n_total){
       belowLOD[[pfas]] <- dat$Sample.Name[which(dat[[pfas]] < lod)]
    
  col_name <- paste0("belowLOD",pfas)
  new_col <- data.frame(col = ifelse(dat[[pfas]] < lod, 1, 0)) 
 colnames(new_col) <- col_name
 dat <- cbind(dat, new_col)

    }
    }
  


knitr::kable(results,digits = 2)

belowLOD
```

```{r}
                filter(visit_name %in% c("Post-24mo", "Post-6mo")  ) %>%

     mutate(
```

```{r}
outcome_var <- c("length_cm","weight_kg", "adjusted_fat_mass_kg", "lean_mass_kg",  "fmi", "ffmi")

lmm_results <- list()

# Loop through each outcome variable
for (outcome in outcome_var) {
  # Construct the formula as a string
  formula_str <- paste(
    outcome, "~  PFHxS.Total + PFOS.Total + PFOA + PFNA + Visitmo + maternal_bmi + sex + bf_length_mo + gest_age_wk + mom_ed + (1 | StudyID.GE)")
  
  # Convert the string to a formula
  model_formula <- as.formula(formula_str)
  
  # Fit the model
  lmm_fit <- lmer(model_formula, data = outcome_data)
  
  # Store the model, named by outcome
  lmm_results[[outcome]] <- summary(lmm_fit) 
}

lmm_results
```

```{r}
outcome_var <- c("length_cm","weight_kg", "adjusted_fat_mass_kg", "lean_mass_kg", "fmi", "ffmi")

indiv_results = list()
# Loop through each outcome variable
for (outcome in outcome_var) {
  out <- vector("list", length(outcome_var))
  for(pfas in pfas_vars) {
  # Construct the formula as a string
  formula_str <- paste(
    outcome, "~", pfas, "+ Visitmo + maternal_bmi + sex + bf_length_mo + gest_age_wk + mom_ed + (1 | StudyID.GE)")
  
   # Convert the string to a formula
  model_formula <- as.formula(formula_str)

  lmm_fit <- lmer(model_formula, data = outcome_data)
  
 coef_mat <- coef(summary(lmm_fit))
 
 ci <- confint(lmm_fit)[pfas, ]
  
  out[[pfas]] <- data.frame(
postnatal_outcome = outcome,
pfas = pfas, 
estimate  = coef_mat[pfas, "Estimate"],
conf.low  = ci[1],
conf.high = ci[2],
p.value   = coef_mat[pfas, "Pr(>|t|)"],
row.names = NULL
)
  }
  indiv_results[[outcome]] <- bind_rows(out)
}

knitr::kable(indiv_results[[1]], digits = 3) 
knitr::kable(indiv_results[[2]], digits = 3) 
knitr::kable(indiv_results[[3]], digits = 3)
knitr::kable(indiv_results[[4]], digits = 3) 
knitr::kable(indiv_results[[5]], digits = 3)
knitr::kable(indiv_results[[6]], digits = 3)
```

```{r}
outcome_wide <- growth_modeling %>% 
                filter(visit_name == "Post-24mo") %>% 
                select(id, visit_name, length_cm, weight_kg, adjusted_fat_mass_kg, lean_mass_kg,  fmi, ffmi, maternal_bmi, sex, gest_age_wk, mom_ed, bf_length_mo,lnPFHxS_T1, lnPFOS_T1, lnPFOA_T1, lnPFNA_T1)  %>% 
    rename(StudyID.GE = id)

pfas_wide <- pfas4.dt %>%
  filter(Study.GE == "Glowing") %>% 
  filter(Visitmo %in% c(6, 24)) %>%
  mutate(across(.cols = pfas_vars, ~ log(.))) %>% 
  select(StudyID.GE, Visitmo, all_of(pfas_vars)) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    id_cols = StudyID.GE,
    names_from = Visitmo,
    values_from = all_of(pfas_vars),
    names_sep = "_"
  ) %>% 
  inner_join(outcome_wide, by = "StudyID.GE") 

pfas_wide <- pfas_wide %>% filter(StudyID.GE %in% unique(outcome_data$StudyID.GE))
```

```{r}
library(qgcomp)
outcome_var <- c("length_cm","weight_kg", "adjusted_fat_mass_kg", "lean_mass_kg","fmi", "ffmi")

out <- vector("list", length(outcome_var))
 
qgcomp_results <- list()

for (outcome in outcome_var) {
  mod1.formula <- as.formula(paste(
    outcome, "~  PFHxS.Total_6 + PFHxS.Total_24",
    "+  PFOS.Total_6 + PFOS.Total_24",
    "+ PFOA_6 + PFOA_24 + PFNA_6 + PFNA_24 + maternal_bmi + bf_length_mo + sex + gest_age_wk + mom_ed")) 
  

 q_gcomp <- qgcomp::qgcomp.noboot(mod1.formula,                                     
                                     expnms= c( "PFHxS.Total_6","PFHxS.Total_24","PFOS.Total_6",  "PFOS.Total_24","PFOA_6", "PFOA_24", "PFNA_6", "PFNA_24"),
                                     dat = pfas_wide, 
                                     family=gaussian(), 
                                     q=4) 
 
  out[[outcome]] = data.frame(
                       outcome = outcome, 
                       estimate = q_gcomp[["psi"]], 
                       psi.ci.ll = q_gcomp$ci.coef[2], 
                       psi.ci.ul = q_gcomp$ci.coef[4], 
                       p.value = q_gcomp[["pval"]][2])
  
}

qgcomp_results <- bind_rows(out)
rownames(qgcomp_results) <- NULL

knitr::kable(qgcomp_results, digits = 3)

```

#bkmr length_cm w T1 
```{r}
library(bkmr)
outcome_name <- "length_cm"

exp_vars <- c(
  "PFHxS.Total_6","PFHxS.Total_24",
  "PFOS.Total_6","PFOS.Total_24",
  "PFOA_6","PFOA_24",
  "PFNA_6","PFNA_24", "lnPFHxS_T1",  "lnPFOS_T1", "lnPFOA_T1", "lnPFNA_T1"
)

covariates <- c("maternal_bmi","bf_length_mo","sex","gest_age_wk","mom_ed") 

dat_bkmr <- pfas_wide %>%
  select(all_of(c("StudyID.GE", outcome_name, exp_vars, covariates))) %>%
  # ensure coding of covariates is meaningful for modeling
  mutate(
    sex = if_else(sex == "Male", 1, 0),            
    mom_ed = if_else(mom_ed == "College Degree", 1, 0)                           # example: treat education as factor
  ) %>% drop_na(all_of(c(outcome_name, exp_vars, covariates)))

nrow(dat_bkmr)

y <- dat_bkmr[[outcome_name]]

# Z = exposures (recommended to center and scale)
Z <- scale(as.matrix(dat_bkmr %>% select(all_of(exp_vars))))
colnames(Z) <- exp_vars

# X = design matrix for covariates (include intercept will be added internally by bkmr)
# Use model.matrix to expand factors into dummy variables
X <- model.matrix(~ maternal_bmi + bf_length_mo + sex + gest_age_wk + mom_ed, data = dat_bkmr)
# remove the intercept column if present (kmbayes handles it internally)
if(colnames(X)[1] == "(Intercept)") X <- X[, -1, drop = FALSE]

# 4) Fit BKMR (a quick test run with small iterations; increase iter & burnin for final analysis)
set.seed(123)
fit_bkmr <- kmbayes(
  y = y,
  Z = Z,
  X = X,
  iter = 5000,     # total MCMC iterations (increase e.g., 20000+ for final)
  varsel = TRUE,   # turn on variable selection (if you want PIPs)
  verbose = TRUE
)



pred.resp.univar <- PredictorResponseUnivar(fit = fit_bkmr)
ggplot(pred.resp.univar, aes(z, est, ymin = est - 1.96*se, ymax = est + 1.96*se)) + 
    geom_smooth(stat = "identity") + 
    facet_wrap(~ variable) +
  ylab("h(z)")

risks.overall <- OverallRiskSummaries(fit = fit_bkmr, y = y, Z = Z, X = X, 
                                      qs = seq(0.25, 0.75, by = 0.05), 
                                      q.fixed = 0.5, method = "exact")

ggplot(risks.overall, aes(quantile, est, ymin = est - 1.96*sd, ymax = est + 1.96*sd)) + 
    geom_pointrange()


risks.singvar <- SingVarRiskSummaries(fit = fit_bkmr, y = y, Z = Z, X = X, 
                                      qs.diff = c(0.25, 0.75), 
                                      q.fixed = c(0.25, 0.50, 0.75),
                                      method = "exact")

ggplot(risks.singvar, aes(variable, est, ymin = est - 1.96*sd, 
                          ymax = est + 1.96*sd, col = q.fixed)) + 
    geom_pointrange(position = position_dodge(width = 0.75)) + 
  coord_flip()
```
